contract: Pombo simple series MVP: six source-labelled sculpture entries, five exact literary texts plus one author card, a separate bibliography annex, bilingual interface, device-voice assistance and essential reading controls. No invented translation, official audio or agent is presented as finished content.

accessibility.evidence: Browser accessibility-tree review confirmed a skip link, semantic headings, labeled navigation and reading controls, six native details disclosures, pressed states for the three preferences, a source disclosure area, and translated labels in both Spanish and English.

responsive.evidence: Rendered reader and six-card sculpture list were inspected at 847x944; responsive CSS was reviewed for 880px, 700px and 420px transitions, wrapped source and controls, stacked bibliography cards, one-column mobile behavior, and touch-sized buttons.

loading.evidence: The local sculpture JSON loads before six entries and the nine-stanza main reader are rendered; the source card remains visible while the text is populated.

empty.reason: The six sculpture entries and the bibliography annex are fixed editorial content; there is no catalogue search or empty-result state.

error.evidence: If the source request fails, the story area shows a clear localized load-error message instead of inventing text.

partial.reason: The simplified cut has no partial catalogue or secondary content surfaces.

success.evidence: The ES/EN switch, six-card render, nine-stanza main reader, bibliography annex, larger-text, high-contrast, reduce-motion and device-voice states all produced visible or accessibility-tree feedback in the browser.

permission.reason: The MVP does not request microphone, camera, location, login, or account permissions.

renderedEvidence.observation: Rendered browser/AX evidence for the six-card series, nine-stanza reader, source links, pending-audio notice and accessibility controls.
Responsive breakpoint review and follow-up note for narrow-device capture.
